803-3000-3510-3875.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3000-3510-3875.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1479-2841-4488-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4488-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

647-3259-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
647-3259-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Urabrask the Hidden can be omitted.

338-2685-4186-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2685-4186-7810.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2897-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2897-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2897-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

206-339-677-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

252-2440-4758-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it. It will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
When the Improvised Arsenal token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Dinosaur you control.
If needed, activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
252-2440-4758-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more Dinosaurs as the combo begins. You should perform step 3 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool.

240-4050-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1305-6575-7297.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

4742-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
4742-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

413-628-7215.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gnarlback Elm.
When Gnarlback Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Gnarlback Elm enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

2511-3991-5987.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

1409-2557-5424.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve the Sailor of Means trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

328-2173-2921-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-2921-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2034-2741-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2741-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1168-1651-2499-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-2499-5967-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-2499-5967-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2043-4050-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {3}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

56-2523-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-2523-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Ratadrabik of Urborg trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-2523-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1049-2438-2440-4871.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{W}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable, or an additional {R}, {W} or {B} if you haven't cast Jirina from the command zone this game
1049-2438-2440-4871.description:
Cast Jirina from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Jirina trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token for each time you've cast Jirina from the command zone this game.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Human and Soldier you control.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining Mana Echoes trigger created in steps 2 and 4.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Jirina and a Human Soldier.
Choose to return Jirina to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Jirina and the Human Soldier die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, if you control a Human Soldier, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a Human Soldier.
If you sacrificed a Human Soldier this way, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 7 and 10, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate up to three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding any combination of {R}, {W} and {B}.
Repeat.

2232-5437-5659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf.
You have at least one nonartifact Lhurgoyf creature card in hand.
2232-5437-5659.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a nonartifact Lhurgoyf card.
Disa the Restless' first ability triggers, putting the discarded Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the Lhurgoyf enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability from step 1.
Repeat.

851-4518-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
851-4518-5554.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1117-1913-3689-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Repeat.

495-500-2557-4688-4751.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nested Shambler.
495-500-2557-4688-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting at least nine +1/+1 counters on Nested Shambler, and the remaining seven +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Kill Nested Shambler, triggering its ability, creating at least twenty 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

369-650-5147.notablePrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-650-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

916-1651-1737-3459.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0}, creating a token copy of Vault of Whispers.
When the Vault of Whispers token enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Battered Golem and the Vault of Whispers token, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1017-1143-3334-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Diviner's Wand attached to Cryptic Trilobite.
1017-1143-3334-4929.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by paying {4}, causing you to draw a card.
Cryptic Trilobite and Wizard Class trigger.
Resolve the Cryptic Trilobite trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Wizard Class trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat

527-3746-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Robaran Mercenaries does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
527-3746-4170.description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{G}.
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping Robaran Mercenaries.
Repeat.

1283-3793-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
1283-3793-4222.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.
